description: This file defines the ISiloStatusOracle interface which provides various methods for querying and subscribing to silo status information within the Orleans runtime. It includes properties for current silo status, name, address, and methods for retrieving active silos, silo statuses, and managing event subscriptions.

classes.name: ISiloStatusOracle
classes.description: An interface acting as an authoritative local source for silo status information within the Orleans cluster.

methods.name: CurrentStatus
methods.description: Property to get the current status of this silo.

methods.name: SiloName
methods.description: Property to get the name of this silo.

methods.name: SiloAddress
methods.description: Property to get the address of this silo.

methods.name: GetActiveSilos
methods.description: Method to retrieve an immutable array of addresses of currently active silos.

methods.name: GetApproximateSiloStatus
methods.description: Method to get the approximate status of a specific silo based on its address.

methods.name: GetApproximateSiloStatuses
methods.description: Method to get a dictionary of all silo addresses and their statuses, optionally only active silos.

methods.name: TryGetSiloName
methods.description: Method to try retrieving the name of a silo given its address.

methods.name: IsFunctionalDirectory
methods.description: Method to determine if a silo is valid for creating new activations or directory lookups.

methods.name: IsDeadSilo
methods.description: Method to check if a specific silo is dead.

methods.name: SubscribeToSiloStatusEvents
methods.description: Method to subscribe to silo status change events, accepting an observer interface.

methods.name: UnSubscribeFromSiloStatusEvents
methods.description: Method to unsubscribe from silo status change events.
